actions.tooltip: Build inner continuation k2 = \\a -> f(a)(k)\nThis closure captures both f and k.\nWhen called with a, it: runs f(a) to get Cont r b, then runs that with k.
Run m with k2: m(k2). m runs LAST — this is the inversion of control.\nIf callCC is used, k (the downstream continuation) can be captured as an escape function.

objects.tooltip: Cont r a = (a ⟶ r) ⟶ r — m is waiting for its continuation. It does not run yet.
(a ⟶ Cont r b) — the continuation step; given a, produces a Cont r b action
(b ⟶ r) — the downstream continuation: what happens after b is produced
(a ⟶ r) — the composed continuation. When m eventually produces a, it calls k2(a), which runs f(a) and then k.
r — the final result of the entire composed computation
